bio_md:
# 宋度宗 · 主要事迹

赵禥为[[s-song-li|理宗]]之侄，理宗无子，立为皇太子，景定五年（1264）即位，改元咸淳。

度宗朝十年，政柄全归贾似道：军国大政皆决于其府，皇帝深居宫中，荒于酒色。咸淳四年（1268）蒙古围襄阳、樊城，宋援不力，守将吕文焕苦守五年；咸淳九年（1273）襄阳陷，吕文焕降，江汉门户自此洞开，南宋之亡局已成。

咸淳十年（1274）度宗崩，子赵显即位，是为[[s-song-gong|恭帝]]。

bio_parts_en.value:
, was made heir and ascended in 1264, era Xianchun.

For all ten years of his reign power lay with Jia Sidao: state affairs were settled in the chancellor's mansion while the emperor lived deep in the palace, lost in wine and women. In 1268 the Mongols besieged Xiangyang and Fancheng; relief was weak, and the defender Lü Wenhuan held for five years. In 1273 Xiangyang fell and Lü surrendered; the gateway of the Yangtze-Han region was flung open, and the doom of Southern Song was sealed.
